title: Dodo nbn 100/20 or 500/50 $62.99/M for 6 Months (New/Return Customers), Stay for 90 Days & Receive $110 Visa eGift Card @ Finder
body:
Deal: Dodo nbn 100/20 or 500/50 $62.99/M for 6 Months (New/Return Customers), Stay for 90 Days & Receive $110 Visa eGift Card @ Finder

[Krykey] NBN companies are dime a dozen now, legit just go with the cheapest deal every 6 months i can lol
[He-Mania] I'm sticking with laptel - their service and pings are great
[Krykey] I miss leaptel, i agree, they are unbeatable for their service and constant connection, and always notified me of outages. but i was with them for 12 months already on their last deal…so must wait to circle round again
[surethang] Just a heads up, the Finder FAQ for the deal says:
Which Dodo NBN products are eligible?
…
The following are NOT ELIGIBLE :
…
* NBN Home Internet BYO Plans
So that sounds like if you sign up on a BYO modem basis, you won't get the reward. Do you have to buy a modem from Dodo to be eligible?
The deal conditions don't make any mention of this, so it's a bit ambiguous at best.
[Krykey] Ah damn i did search the T&Cs for the any mention of BYO not being included for the deal, and it didnt mention it so i assumed it was included
Surely they cant just put it in their FAQ page, and not the actual T&Cs for the deal itself right, you agree to a promotion/deals T&Cs not the FAQ, sounds a bit like a breach of Aus consumer law if it is excluded and not explicitly stated.
Guess ill contact support tomorrow see, or follow up with ACCC lol
[vash12] Finder is extremely slow. I signed up for the Optus pre-paid deal 6 months ago and its still showing as "pending" for the VISA e-card in my account.
[Krykey] Damn if its been that long, you should probably contact them as it sounds like it hasnt even been tracked for you. the $350 optus deal tracked fine and came in on its said payment date for me correctly.
[Dyl] July 1st was the cutoff for the Feb deal, contact their chat.
Mine showed up on the day they stated in terms.
[Dyl] How is Dodo / Vocus these days in comparison? On paper they look strong with all the merges, but I've not tried them for a while.
[Techefy] Why buy this uncertain deal when there is a $50 nbn deal
[Futura] Down vote due to the current AI generated ads they're running on TV currently.
[Krykey] dunno what this has in relation to it being a deal or not, more a subjective view of your stance on the company? but ok
